title: Just Keep Swimming
description: Guide a clownfish through an endless jellyfish drift, threading bubble rings, bouncing off bells, and protecting a growing combo.

prompt.objective: Build an underwater runner where a small fish threads scoring gates and uses jellyfish as risky speed boosts.

mintAssets.brief: A cheerful striped fish, bubble-ring gates, jellyfish, kelp, coral, anemones, and seabed rocks.

experience: Steer through an endless underwater field while a limited boost reserve regenerates.
Grow combos through rings, bounce off bells for speed, and let tentacle stings punish without ending the run.
prompt.visualDirection: Colorful storybook ocean, soft fog, playful rounded UI, glowing jellyfish, and buoyant motion.

thumbnail.alt: A striped clownfish swimming toward a bubble ring through a bright blue jellyfish-filled ocean.

social.title: Just Keep Swimming
social.description: Thread the rings, bounce the bells, and keep an endless underwater combo alive.

image.alt: A striped clownfish swimming toward a bubble ring through a bright blue jellyfish-filled ocean.
